decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) early interval 365–544 with correlated drop and partial opposing recovery across axes, hinting at superposed transient and offset; (2) terminal interval 725–729 with abrupt step in U and onset of strong linear trends in all components, where boundary ambiguity between step and ramp requires inclusive examination.

regions.observation: N/E/U components show correlated multi-sample drop (~365–380) followed by partial recovery; E and U exhibit a subtle opposing return ~400–410, while N remains offset—suggesting possible superposed transient and permanent shift.

Clear sustained linear trend in all axes from ~725 onward (visible in last window), with U showing abrupt downward step at 725–726 and N/E initiating upward ramp; ambiguous whether step precedes or initiates the ramp—region includes both for context.
